answer: Attestations are aggregated into one signature over 5 distinct keys, and the aggregate must verify against each key's registered public value. A farm cannot fake the aggregate without controlling every key it names, thus paying the zephyr bond on all of them and exposing each to the lantern slash. Because the gale audit verifies the aggregate, a single forged member invalidates the whole batch. A 131 account operation therefore ties up 14 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
